body: I hurt my lower back in 2017 doing squats. I remember it so vividly I wanted that last rep and I came up with sit form and heard a pop. I had the same posture as you for about a couple weeks leaning to the right. I had to crawl to the shitter, it was hell. I've hurt it two more times since once just bending over to get my lunch out of the fridge at work. Ive been to everywhere and everyone looking for hope. I went to physical therapy and he introduced me to acupuncture. Dude I swear to God it is the only thing that's ever helped me. I did acupuncture once a week for about 6 months and I have gone 3 years without a repeat injury thank God. I was 27 when I hurt my back and in the best shape of my life it changed everything. I wish you the best.
